name: keyctl-read
description: Block keyctl subcommands that print kernel keyring payloads.

rules.name: block-keyctl-read
rules.reason: keyctl read prints a keyring payload.

rules.name: block-keyctl-pipe
rules.reason: keyctl pipe writes a keyring payload to stdout.

rules.name: block-keyctl-print
rules.reason: keyctl print dumps a keyring payload.
